name: ready
description: Check task readiness against requirements, static checks, and browser QA.

READY_CHECK_RULES.description: Your coding rules, one per entry, for example "Prefer switch over long if/elseif chains". Start a rule with MUST: to make the Ready Check review block on it. Separate rules with new lines.

READY_CHECK_TASK_COMMENT_TEMPLATE.description: Path to a UTF-8 Markdown template for task comments. Use an absolute path or a path relative to the repository.
